preconditions.description: The duration of charging a is between 1 and 1000 seconds.
The duration of shooting b is between 1 and 1000 seconds.
The x-coordinate of point A is between -10000 and 10000.
The y-coordinate of point A is between -10000 and 10000.
The x-coordinate of point B is between -10000 and 10000.
The y-coordinate of point B is between -10000 and 10000.
The number of trenches n is between 1 and 1000.
All trench coordinates are between -10000 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all((x1 == x2) != (y1 == y2) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in trenches)
preconditions.description: Each trench is either horizontal or vertical.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x1 - x2) <= b or abs(y1 - y2) <= b for x1, y1, x2, y2 in trenches)
preconditions.description: The length of any trench does not exceed b.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a non-negative float representing the minimum time.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all((time % (a + b) < a) or (time % (a + b) >= a and time % (a + b) < a + b) for time in range(int(return_value) + 1))
postconditions.description: If Vasya can reach point B, the time must allow him to avoid the laser shots.
